content:
Ana Patel: Hey all — trying to lock a time for the API/SDK/Console design review (new auth+streaming payloads). I put a short pre-read and checklist below. Please vote on times and call out any blockers.

Ana Patel: Proposed agenda (30m):
1) 5m - Context & goals (Ana)
2) 10m - API surface and SDK changes (Kevin)
3) 8m - Console UX flows (Elaine)
4) 5m - Rollout plan + what to watch in telemetry (Sam)

Ana Patel: Pre-read (tl;dr): PR + proto examples, perf targets, a couple UI mockups. Link: https://redwood/repo/pulls/4123
Checklist to skim before meeting:```- PR diff + test plan
- Mockups: console/users/auth-flow.png
- Perf targets: latency < 120ms p95 for hosted tier
- Backwards compatibility notes for SDK v2 -> v3```

Mike Chen: Available windows (PST): Tue 10:30-11:30, Wed 14:00-15:00, Thu 09:00-10:00. Prefer Wed.

Sophia Li: Wed 14:00 conflicts for me (customer call). Thu morning works if we can keep it concise.

Kevin Ortiz: I can present API/SDK at any of those times except Tue morning. Quick ask: can folks review the auth section (lines 120-190 in the PR) — that's where the compatibility constraints are.

Elaine Gomez: I'll take Console UX. Quick note: UI mockups include a compact path for teams that use Reserved capacity. Need to confirm text sizes and copy.

Sam (Product): I'll cover rollout/telemetry. Suggest we add a fallback/resilience slide for Dedicated vs Hosted routing. Also, please add a short prompt set we can use for regression checks.

Ana Patel: Rough poll: react with :thumbsup: for Wed 14:00, :eyes: for Thu 09:00, :hand: for Tue 10:30. I'll tally in ~90m.

Mike Chen: :thumbsup: (Wed)

Kevin Ortiz: :hand: (Tue)

Elaine Gomez: :eyes: (Thu)

Sophia Li: :eyes: (Thu)

Sam (Product): :thumbsup: (Wed) but if Sophia can't make it, Thu ok for me.

calendar-bot: Reminder: draft invite created for "API/SDK/Console review" — Wed 2026-04-15 14:00-14:30 PDT. Attendees: Ana Patel, Mike Chen, Kevin Ortiz, Elaine Gomez, Sam (Product). Link: https://calendar/ev/abc123

Ana Patel: If Sophia can't make Wed, we can record and run a 1:1 walk-through after. Elaine/Kevin please add 3 quick slides each: one for risks, one for migration notes, one for rollout checklist.

Kevin Ortiz: Will add slides and short code snippet showing old vs new call pattern:```old: client.request({model, prompt})
new: client.stream({model, prompt, onChunk})```

Elaine Gomez: I'll upload the mockups and copy variants to the PR by EOD.

Sam (Product): I'll draft the regression prompts — posting a gist in the PR in ~2hrs.

Mike Chen: One more ask: can eng-sre do a quick perf sanity on the new streaming path before the review? If yes, tag @eng-sre in the PR comments.

Sophia Li: If I can't make Wed, I'll leave detailed comments on the PR and record a 6-min walkthrough.

deploy-bot: Note: staging deploy of branch auth-streaming-4123 scheduled tonight at 02:30 UTC. Test cluster: staging-infer-3.

Ana Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll finalize the invite after 90m and add the pre-read checklist to the calendar event. If you want to present, mark yourself as presenter in the event or DM me.

Kevin Ortiz: Thanks — will mark.

Elaine Gomez: Got it, thanks.

Sam (Product): 👍

Mike Chen: See you all (or the recording).
